title: Dual-oxygen pancreatic cancer organoids recapitulate basal-classical heterogeneity validated by spatial transcriptomics.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) comprises heterogeneous classical and basal-like subtypes. Although pancreatic cancer organoids (PCOs) are widely used, normoxic cultures preferentially maintain the classical subtype, limiting their ability to represent intrinsic intratumoral heterogeneity.
